method: Actual keyboard movement, E search/extraction, R return and E/arrow/Enter repair. Full geometry is read for diagnostic routing. Preparation opens through the normal scene method. No field reward, HP, chaos, clock or position injection. Natural runs use normal world selection and owned gear; controlled build/world and fixed defect identity are explicit fixtures recorded below.
encounters: Current visible opponents/hosts and 5s last-seen memory; observed positions/facing, no hidden detection or patrol futures. Contextual known tools, evasion and guarded search.
slotPolicy: Runtime public slot count and last passive index; active keys from GAME_CONSTANTS.CONTAMINANT.SORTIE_ACTIVE_KEYS. Never press a passive slot.
strategy: Follow one fixed far physical direction, interrupt travel for actually observed uncollected non-deferred remains farther than320px from entry, search, then resume that direction while the observed return budget permits. Never inspect hidden content kind/tier/value. Return preserves the exit identity and responds only to currently seen short-leg threats with at most four280ms supported evade inputs; it then continues a body-supported path without voluntary pursuit or search-window fighting. Cumulative evade-input budget is1120ms and no further evasion starts after4000ms measured evasion work. The existing60s return-route cap remains. Current effective movement speed informs the estimated return budget; future pressure/speed degradation is not forecast.
surveyKnowledge: Only paid, currently displayed six-second position snapshots; no enemy identity, facing or live positions beyond visibility.
managementPolicy: Pay actual repairs toward earned entry service targets CORE51/PURIFIER51/STORAGE100 before growth. Only then invest publicly available growth with actual maintenance reserve. Funds or tools are never granted.
observedWindowPolicy: Permit a 28px body-supported short approach behind currently observed non-approaching enemies; reobserve every350ms. No AI state or future patrol access.
